lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in three to four visible horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting semi-regular spacing along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like visual structure on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.
